text:
zoe: starting a short deploy window for model-routing-v3. plan: micro-ramp 8->40->100 with an automated soft-unwind on small error blips. need pin/backout commands and paging thresholds. oncall? :eyes:
deploy-bot: queued: `/deploy start --ff model_route_v3 --ramp 8,40,100 --notes "micro-ramp soft-unwind"`

rafael: recommend: soft-unwind if agent.api.5xx_rate > 0.7% over 4m. if it persists 9m escalate to full pin to v2. immediate pin for session-affecting endpoints.

dina: Add alerting: page on sustained 5xx >1% for 5m. chat alerts at 0.7% over 4m to #incidents only. suppress retriggers for 7m after a soft-unwind.

ops_alex: manual pin: `/ff pin model_route_v3 --to-version v2 --percent 100 --reason "escalation"`. to unpin: `/ff unpin model_route_v3 --percent 0 --reason "revert after fix"`.

zoe: pasted small ops config to runbook and release notes. starting canary now (canary_ts=1731234600). monitoring links: `/metrics query agent.api.5xx_rate --window 4m --ff model_route_v3` and `/rollout history model_route_v3`.
deploy-bot: Canary at 8% done. no page events. scheduling 40% in 9m.

rafael: Ill watch p95 and 5xx. hold ramp if p95 >220ms or 5xx crosses 0.7% for 2 consecutive 4m windows.

zoe: ok team, keep posting short updates here. this thread is canonical for the rollout. :rocket:
